Content:
FAQ

What is Tamkeen Plus Credit Card?

Tamkeen Plus is a high limit sharia compliant credit card allows for flexible repayment. The Card has a profit rate of 1.8% per month

Is Tamkeen Plus credit card compatible with sharia committee?

Tamkeen Plus credit card is based on murabaha financing where goods are purchased and sold with the customer's consent to issue the card.

Are there any interest or profit fees on the card?

(Tamkeen Plus credit card offers you the one of the lowest profit rates at 1.8% per month as part of your monthly allowance on your card) however, when you pay the full amount due on time, there will be no profit on the card. 

What are the payments due date on Tamkeen Plus credit card?
Source: F:\AI\Ai  real Project\AIHousingAssistant\AIHousingAssistant\ProcessingFolder\Tamkeen Plus Infinite Credit Card.docx

Content:
What are the payments due date on Tamkeen Plus credit card?  

Payment is automatically made on the 25th of each calendar month. Cardholder may opt to pay (5 % of the outstanding balance or minimum of 200 , whichever is higher) of the balance.

Can the customer make an early payment for Tamkeen Plus credit card?

Yes, the customer can make a payment via Albilad Net or Albilad App

What is the point-of-sale limit for Tamkeen Plus credit card?

100% of the credit limit available for the card. 

What is the cash withdrawal limit for Tamkeen Plus credit card?

Cash withdrawal limit is capped at 30% of the total card limit. 

Is it possible to add additional funds to Tamkeen plus credit card? 

Yes, a balance can be added above the credit card limit.
Source: F:\AI\Ai  real Project\AIHousingAssistant\AIHousingAssistant\ProcessingFolder\Tamkeen Plus Infinite Credit Card.docx

After completing the application, will the customer receive a physical card?

After completing the application, the customer will be requested to activate the virtual card. In case the customer wants a physical card, he/ she can request one through Albilad App (Delivery and printing fees are applied).

In case customer did not sign the commodity contract or promissory note in time, will his application be cancelled?
Source: F:\AI\Ai  real Project\AIHousingAssistant\AIHousingAssistant\ProcessingFolder\Tamkeen Plus Infinite Credit Card.docx

Content:
Yes, if customer did not sign within the time limit, his/ her application will be cancelled, and an SMS will be sent to him/ her

In case customer did not sell the commodity in time, will his application be cancelled?

No, the bank system will sell on his/ her behalf, and an SMS will notify him/ her to complete the application through Albilad app

In case there are missing documents from the customer application, will he be required to go to the branch to provide them?

Customer should resume the application online and submit the missing documents through Albilad app without the need to visit the branch

FAQs

What is the welcome points offer I will receive?

You will earn welcome points upon issuing and activating the physical card and enrolling in the Albilad Rewards Program.

Do I need to make purchases or point-of-sale transactions to receive the welcome points?

No, welcome points are awarded without the need for any purchases or point-of-sale transactions.

Can I convert my welcome points into cash in my current account?

Yes, all points, whether earned from purchases or welcome points, can be converted into cash in your current account through the Albilad Rewards Program.
Source: F:\AI\Ai  real Project\AIHousingAssistant\AIHousingAssistant\ProcessingFolder\Tamkeen Plus Infinite Credit Card.docx

Content:
Is there a difference in the value of points when redeemed as cashback or shopping vouchers?

No, there is no differencethe points hold the same value across all redemption options in the Albilad Rewards Program.

How can I use my points?

You can redeem your points for a variety of rewards, including:

  • Flight tickets

  • Hotel bookings

  • Shopping

  • Points transfer

  • Donating points

  • Cashback redemption

When will the welcome points be credited?

Welcome points will be credited upon linking the newly issued cards to the Albilad Rewards Program.

Is registration in the Albilad Rewards Program required?

Yes, you must register in the Albilad Rewards Program to receive the welcome points.

When will the additional points be added to my balance?
Source: F:\AI\Ai  real Project\AIHousingAssistant\AIHousingAssistant\ProcessingFolder\Tamkeen Plus Infinite Credit Card.docx

Content:
When will the additional points be added to my balance?

The additional points will be credited to your Albilad Rewards balance within 30 days after the promotion period ends.

How many times can I benefit from the welcome points offer?

The welcome points offer is available only once per customer.

Do I need to manually add the newly issued card to the Albilad Rewards Program, or will it be added automatically?

Yes, you must manually add your new card to the Albilad Rewards Program.

Can you explain the 2.15% cashback offer?

For every  1 spent using the Tamkeen Plus Card, you will earn up to 6.5 points in the Albilad Rewards Program, which translates to a return of up to 2.15% on your spending.

Will I receive the cashback directly on the card?
Source: F:\AI\Ai  real Project\AIHousingAssistant\AIHousingAssistant\ProcessingFolder\Tamkeen Plus Infinite Credit Card.docx

Content:
Will I receive the cashback directly on the card?

No, you will earn points in the Albilad Rewards Program, which you can convert into cashback of up to 2.15% of your total spending.

What will happen if I dont spend the mentioned amount?

You will not get the extra points
